properties.displayName: Successful Internal to Public Connections using Putty
properties.description: This alert indicates that a user has successfully connected from an internal IP to a public Network using PuTTY, a terminal emulator and network file transfer application. This could be a sign of unauthorised or malicious activity, such as data exfiltration, remote access, or command execution.
properties.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| where LocalIPType == "Private"
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine contains "putty.exe"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    DeviceName,
    InitiatingProcessAccountName,
    LocalIP,
    RemoteIP,
    RemoteUrl,
    RemotePort

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Successful Internal to Public Connections using Putty

properties.displayName: DNS Tunneling Detected
properties.description: Anomalous DNS activity consistent with tunneling techniques has been detected. This alert indicates potential covert data exfiltration or command-and-control (C2) communication via DNS channels. Investigate further to determine if this activity poses a security risk.
properties.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where ActionType == "NetworkSignatureInspected"
| extend AF = parse_json(AdditionalFields)
| extend NetworkSignature = AF.SignatureName
//Search for network signatures that are DNS but not on regular DNS ports including Netbios & LLMNR if those are in use
| where NetworkSignature == "DNS_Request" and RemotePort !in ("53", "137", "5353", "5355")
//Exclude traffic where the remote IP is a private/local IP address, you can remove this if also interested in that traffic
| where not(ipv4_is_private(RemoteIP))
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    DeviceName,
    NetworkSignature,
    LocalIP,
    LocalPort,
    RemoteIP,
    RemotePort,
    RemoteUrl

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: DNS Tunneling Detected

properties.displayName: [DefenseEvasion] Indicator Removal Activity Detected
properties.description:
This alert detects attempts to remove indicators of compromise (IOCs) from a system,
such as clearing event logs or deleting forensic artifacts. These actions are commonly
used by attackers to evade detection and hinder incident response efforts.

Investigate the user and process responsible for this activity.
Review recent alerts or suspicious behaviour on the same device.
properties.query:
DeviceFileEvents
| where ActionType == "FileDeleted"
// File extensions commonly associated with logs & forensics
| where FileName endswith ".log"
    or FileName endswith ".json"
    or FileName endswith ".evtx"
    or FileName endswith ".txt"
    or FileName endswith ".etl"
    or FileName endswith ".csv"
    or FileName endswith ".xml"
// Sensitive directories for log / artifact deletion
| where FolderPath has_any (
      @"\Windows\System32\winevt\Logs",
      @"\Windows\System32\LogFiles",
      @"\Windows\System32\config",
      @"\AppData\Local\Temp",
      @"\AppData\Roaming",
      @"\ProgramData",
      @"\$Recycle.Bin",
      @"\Users\Public",
      @"\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Windows\WebCache",
      @"\NTUSER.DAT",
      @"\SAM",
      @"\System32\Tasks"
  )
| extend LowerFolderPath = tolower(FolderPath)
| where not (LowerFolderPath has_any ("tempinstalls", "cache"))
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    DeviceName,
    InitiatingProcessAccountName,
    FileName,
    FolderPath,
    InitiatingProcessFileName,
    InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: [DefenseEvasion] Indicator Removal Activity Detected

properties.displayName: [DefenseEvasion] A User Has Cleared the Windows Security Audit Log
properties.description:
A user has cleared the Windows Security Audit Log (Event ID 1102).
This action is extremely rare during normal operations and is often associated with
attacker activity attempting to hide evidence or evade detection.

Investigate the initiating account and device immediately.
properties.query:
Windows_Security_Logs_CL
| where EventID_d == 1102
| extend ActorUser = tostring(LogFileCleared_SubjectUserName_s)
| extend Computer = tostring(column_ifexists("Computer_s", column_ifexists("Computer", "")))
| project TimeGenerated, ActorUser, Computer, EventID = EventID_d

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: [DefenseEvasion] A User Has Cleared the Windows Security Audit Log

| extend SentinelResourceName = tostring(SentinelResourceName)
| extend Description = tostring(Description)

properties.displayName: VBA Macro Execution Detected via Office Document
properties.description: This alert detects the execution of VBA macros embedded in Microsoft Office documents. VBA macros are commonly used by threat actors to deliver malware, establish persistence, or execute malicious payloads. This activity is often associated with phishing campaigns or malicious email attachments.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName endswith ".doc" or
        InitiatingProcessFileName endswith ".docx" or
        InitiatingProcessFileName endswith ".xls" or
        InitiatingProcessFileName endswith ".xlsx" or
        InitiatingProcessFileName endswith ".ppt" or
        InitiatingProcessFileName endswith ".pptx"
| where FileName in~ ("winword.exe", "excel.exe", "powerpnt.exe") // Office applications
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("VBA", "macro", "/m", "/x", "/r", "AutoOpen", "Auto_Close", "Workbook_Open")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ReportId

properties.displayName: Execution of File with Double Extension Detected

properties.displayName: [InitialAccess] Vulnerable pac4j-jwt Library Detected
properties.description:
DO NOT EDIT IN PORTAL - MANAGED VIA GIT REPO.

An authentication bypass vulnerability in pac4j-jwt allows remote
attackers to forge encrypted JWTs containing arbitrary subject and
role claims, resulting in unauthorized access as valid users.

This rule identifies Linux hosts containing vulnerable versions of
the pac4j-jwt authentication library.

Affected versions:
pac4j-jwt < 4.5.9
pac4j-jwt < 5.7.9
pac4j-jwt < 6.3.3

Reach out to the application owner to request removal or patching
of this vulnerable package.
properties.query:
let VulnerablePac4j =
DeviceFileEvents
| where FileName endswith ".jar"
| where FileName startswith "pac4j-jwt"
| extend Pac4jVersion = extract(@"pac4j-jwt-([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)",1,FileName)
| where isnotempty(Pac4jVersion)
| extend Major = toint(split(Pac4jVersion,".")[0]),
         Minor = toint(split(Pac4jVersion,".")[1]),
         Patch = toint(split(Pac4jVersion,".")[2])
| where
    (Major == 4 and (Minor < 5 or (Minor == 5 and Patch < 9))) or
    (Major == 5 and (Minor < 7 or (Minor == 7 and Patch < 9))) or
    (Major == 6 and (Minor < 3 or (Minor == 3 and Patch < 3)))
| extend FullFilePath = strcat(FolderPath, "/", FileName)
| project DeviceId,
          DeviceName,
          FullFilePath,
          FileName,
          SHA1,
          Pac4jVersion;

VulnerablePac4j
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceInfo
    | where OSPlatform == "Linux"
    | project DeviceId, HostName=DeviceName
) on DeviceId
| project HostName,
          FullFilePath,
          FileName,
          SHA1,
          Pac4jVersion

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: [InitialAccess] {{HostName}} – Vulnerable pac4j-jwt {{Pac4jVersion}} Detected
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Host {{HostName}} contains vulnerable pac4j-jwt {{Pac4jVersion}} at {{FullFilePath}}

properties.displayName: [Collection] Suspicious Email Forwarding Configuration Detected
properties.description:
This alert triggers when suspicious email forwarding configuration activity is detected.
Specifically, it identifies cases where the "Set-Mailbox" action changes the mailbox-level
ForwardingSmtpAddress parameter. This behaviour should always be investigated.
properties.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType == "Set-Mailbox"
| extend UserUPN = tostring(RawEventData.UserId)
| extend Params = parse_json(tostring(RawEventData.Parameters))
| extend ForwardingSetting = tostring(Params[1].Name)
| extend ForwardingAddressRaw = tostring(Params[1].Value)
| extend StoreAndForwardSetting = tostring(Params[2].Name)
| extend StoreAndForwardValue = tostring(Params[2].Value)
| where ForwardingSetting == "ForwardingSmtpAddress" and isnotempty(ForwardingAddressRaw)
| extend FwdSMTP = split(ForwardingAddressRaw, ":")[-1]
// Derive Account entity identifiers from UPN
| extend AccountName = tostring(split(UserUPN, "@")[0])
| extend UPNSuffix = iif(indexof(UserUPN, "@") > 0, tostring(split(UserUPN, "@")[1]), "")
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    UserUPN,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    IPAddress,
    FwdSMTP,
    StoreAndForwardValue

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: [Collection] Suspicious Email Forwarding Configuration Detected

properties.displayName: [Execution] MD5 Hash Matches Malware Reported on MalwareBazaar
properties.description:
MalwareBazaar is a community-driven malware sharing platform for newly observed malware samples.
This analytic rule loads the latest MD5 hashes published by MalwareBazaar and looks for matches
in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint DeviceFileEvents. Any match should be treated as potentially
malicious and investigated promptly.
properties.query:
// Pull the most recent MD5 list (plain text) from MalwareBazaar
let MalwareBazaarMD5s =
    externaldata(MD5: string)
    ["https://bazaar.abuse.ch/export/txt/md5/recent"]
    with (format="txt", ignoreFirstRecord=true)
    | where MD5 matches regex '^[A-Fa-f0-9]{32}$'
    | extend MD5_lower = tolower(MD5)
    | distinct MD5_lower;
// Normalize and match by MD5 (lowercase)
DeviceFileEvents
| where isnotempty(MD5)
| extend MD5_lower = tolower(MD5)
| join kind=innerunique MalwareBazaarMD5s on MD5_lower
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    DeviceName,
    DeviceId,
    FileName,
    FolderPath,
    SHA256,
    MD5,
    InitiatingProcessAccountName,
    InitiatingProcessFileName,
    InitiatingProcessCommandLine

properties.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType == "Set-Mailbox"
| extend UserId = tostring(RawEventData.UserId)

properties.displayName: Dataverse - User bulk retrieval outside normal activity
properties.description: Identifies users retrieving significantly more records from Dataverse than they have previously in the past 2 weeks.
properties.query:
let baseline_time = 14d;
let detection_time = 1d;
DataverseActivity
| where TimeGenerated between(ago(baseline_time) .. ago(detection_time - 1d))
| where Message == "RetrieveMultiple"
| extend numQueryCount = todouble(QueryResults)
| extend QueryCount = iif(QueryResults contains ",", todouble(countof(tostring(QueryResults), ',') + 1), numQueryCount)
| extend QueryCount = iif(isnotempty(QueryCount), QueryCount, double(1))
| summarize sum(QueryCount) by UserId
| extend HistoricalBaseline = sum_QueryCount
| join kind=inner (
    DataverseActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(detection_time)
    | where Message == "RetrieveMultiple"
    | extend numQueryCount = todouble(QueryResults)
    | extend QueryCount = iif(QueryResults contains ",", todouble(countof(tostring(QueryResults), ',') + 1), numQueryCount)
    | extend QueryCount = iif(isnotempty(QueryCount), QueryCount, double(1))
    | summarize sum(QueryCount) by UserId
    | extend CurrentExportRate = sum_QueryCount)
    on UserId
| where CurrentExportRate > HistoricalBaseline
| project UserId, HistoricalBaseline, CurrentExportRate
| join kind=inner(
    DataverseActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(detection_time)
    | where Message == "RetrieveMultiple"
    | extend numQueryCount = todouble(QueryResults)
    | extend QueryCount = iif(QueryResults contains ",", todouble(countof(tostring(QueryResults), ',') + 1), numQueryCount)
    | extend QueryCount = iif(isnotempty(QueryCount), QueryCount, double(1)))
    on UserId
| summarize
    QuerySizes = make_set(QueryCount),
    MostRecentQuery = max(TimeGenerated),
    IPs = make_set(ClientIp),
    UserAgents = make_set(UserAgent),
    Entities = make_set(EntityName),
    Queries = make_set(Query)
    by UserId, InstanceUrl, HistoricalBaseline, CurrentExportRate
| extend
    AccountName = tostring(split(UserId, '@')[0]),

properties.displayName: D365 - Mass export of records to Excel
properties.description:
The query detects user exporting a large amount of records from Dynamics 365 
to Excel, significantly more records exported than any other recent activity 
by that user.
properties.query:
let baseline_time = 14d;
let detection_time = 1d;
// Set a mass export threshold for users who have no historical activity.
let massExportThreshold = 100;
Dynamics365Activity
| where TimeGenerated between(ago(baseline_time) .. ago(detection_time))
| where OriginalObjectId contains 'ExportToExcel'
| extend numQueryCount = todouble(QueryResults)
| extend QueryCount = iif(QueryResults contains ",", todouble(countof(tostring(QueryResults), ',') + 1), numQueryCount)
| extend QueryCount = iif(isnotempty(QueryCount), QueryCount, double(1))
| summarize sum(QueryCount) by HistoricalUserId = UserId
| extend HistoricalBaseline = sum_QueryCount
| join kind=rightouter (Dynamics365Activity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(detection_time)
    | where OriginalObjectId contains 'ExportToExcel'
    | extend numQueryCount = todouble(QueryResults)
    | extend QueryCount = iif(QueryResults contains ",", todouble(countof(tostring(QueryResults), ',') + 1), numQueryCount)
    | extend QueryCount = iif(isnotempty(QueryCount), QueryCount, double(1))
    | summarize sum(QueryCount) by UserId = UserId
    | extend CurrentExportRate = sum_QueryCount)
    on $left.HistoricalUserId == $right.UserId
| extend HistoricalBaseline = iif(isnotnull(HistoricalBaseline), HistoricalBaseline, todouble(massExportThreshold))
| where CurrentExportRate > HistoricalBaseline
| project UserId, HistoricalBaseline, CurrentExportRate
| join kind=inner(Dynamics365Activity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(detection_time)
    | where OriginalObjectId contains 'ExportToExcel'
    | extend numQueryCount = todouble(QueryResults)
    | extend QueryCount = iif(QueryResults contains ",", todouble(countof(tostring(QueryResults), ',') + 1), numQueryCount)

properties.displayName: Active Scanning
properties.description:
This alert triggers when an external IP address attempts connections to more than 20 unique ports on an internal host within a 5-minute window. Such activity is indicative of active scanning, a common reconnaissance technique used by attackers to identify open ports and potential vulnerabilities before launching further attacks.

If this alert is triggered, investigate the source IP to determine if it’s trusted or known to be malicious, and check threat intelligence feeds for reputation. Review the targeted internal host for signs of compromise or unusual exposure, and correlate with other alerts from the same source IP
properties.query:

NetworkAccessTraffic
| where SourceIp !startswith "10." // Exclude internal IPs (adjust for your network)
| where Action == "Allow"
| summarize PortCount = dcount(DestinationPort), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)

| where PortCount > 20 // Threshold: more than 20 ports in 5 minutes
| project SourceIp, DestinationIp, PortCount, FirstSeen, LastSeen

properties.displayName: [Collection] Double click jacking alert - WIP
properties.description:
DO NOT EDIT IN PORTAL - MANAGED VIA GIT REPO.

Heuristic detection for potential double-click UI redressing / clickjacking activity.
Looks for rapid, repeated process executions that include the same URL/arguments within a short window,
grouped by Computer, User, Domain, and CommandLine.

NOTE: This is a best-effort heuristic using SecurityEvent (Event ID 4688). It does not rely on hidden iframes.
Please let Ieuan know when this alerts so we can iterate.
properties.query:
// --- Tunables ---
let minClicksPerMinute = 5;  // Minimum repeated executions in a 1-minute bucket to alert
let allowedDomains = dynamic(["localhost", "127.0.0.1"]); // Add sanctioned domains to reduce noise
let suspiciousFocusOnly = false; // Set to true to only include domains listed in suspiciousDomains
let suspiciousDomains = dynamic([]); // Optionally add known suspicious domains here

// --- Helper: extract domain from a URL in a command line ---
let with_url = 
    SecurityEvent
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where isnotempty(CommandLine)
    | where CommandLine has_any ("http://", "https://")
    | extend Domain = tostring(extract(@"https?://([^/\s]+)", 1, CommandLine))
    | where isnotempty(Domain)
    // Optional include-only list (disabled by default)
    | where suspiciousFocusOnly == false or Domain in~ (suspiciousDomains)
    // Exclude allowlisted domains
    | where Domain !in~ (allowedDomains);

// Detect fast repeats in 1-minute buckets per Computer/User/Domain/CommandLine
with_url
| summarize
    Clicks = count(),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), Computer, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName, Domain, CommandLine
| where Clicks >= minClicksPerMinute
| extend
    AccountName = tostring(SubjectUserName),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(SubjectDomainName),
    timestamp = LastSeen
| project
    timestamp,
    FirstSeen,
    LastSeen,
    Clicks,
    Computer,
    AccountName,
    UPNSuffix,
    Domain,
    CommandLine

properties.displayName: [Collection] Exchange workflow MailItemsAccessed operation anomaly
properties.description:
DO NOT EDIT IN PORTAL - MANAGED VIA GIT REPO.

Identifies anomalous increases in Exchange MailItemsAccessed operations.
Uses built-in series anomaly detection to flag spikes in access activity.
Sudden increases should be investigated for potential account compromise or exfiltration attempts.

Adjust 'scorethreshold' (default 1.5) to reduce noise.
properties.query:
let starttime = 14d;
let timeframe = 1h;
let scorethreshold = 1.5;
let percentthreshold = 50;

// Prepare time series (MailItemsAccessed count per hour) from 14d ago through now so we can detect anomalies in the last 1d
let TimeSeriesData =
    OfficeActivity
    | where TimeGenerated between (startofday(ago(starttime)) .. now())
    | where OfficeWorkload =~ "Exchange"
      and Operation =~ "MailItemsAccessed"
      and ResultStatus =~ "Succeeded"
    | project TimeGenerated
    | make-series Total = count() on TimeGenerated
        from startofday(ago(starttime))
        to now()
        step timeframe;

// Detect anomalies
let TimeSeriesAlerts =
    TimeSeriesData
    | extend (anomalies, score, baseline) =
        series_decompose_anomalies(Total, scorethreshold, -1, 'linefit')
    | mv-expand
        Total to typeof(double),
        TimeGenerated to typeof(datetime),
        anomalies to typeof(double),
        score to typeof(double),
        baseline to typeof(long)
    | where anomalies > 0
    | project TimeGenerated, Total, baseline, anomalies, score;

// Join anomalous hours with actual MailItemsAccessed logs for context.
// Restrict to last 1d only so we don't re-alert on the same anomaly every day (queryFrequency is P1D).
TimeSeriesAlerts
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| join kind=innerunique (
    OfficeActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
    | extend DateHour = bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
    | where OfficeWorkload =~ "Exchange"
      and Operation =~ "MailItemsAccessed"
      and ResultStatus =~ "Succeeded"
    | summarize
        HourlyCount = count(),
        TimeGeneratedMax = arg_max(TimeGenerated, *),
        IPList = make_set(Client_IPAddress, 1000),
        MaxIP = arg_max(Client_IPAddress, *),
        ClientInfoStringList = make_set(ClientInfoString, 1000)
      by MailboxOwnerUPN, Logon_Type, TenantId, UserType, TimeGenerated = bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
    | where HourlyCount > 25  // reduce noise
) on TimeGenerated
| extend PercentofTotal = round(HourlyCount / Total, 2) * 100
| where PercentofTotal > percentthreshold
| project-reorder
    TimeGeneratedMax,
    OfficeWorkload,
    Operation,
    MailboxOwnerUPN,
    MaxIP,
    IPList,
    ClientInfoStringList,
    HourlyCount,
    PercentofTotal,
    Total,
    baseline,
    score,
    anomalies
| extend
    AccountName = tostring(split(MailboxOwnerUPN, "@")[0]),
    AccountUPNSuffix = tostring(split(MailboxOwnerUPN, "@")[1]),
    timestamp = TimeGeneratedMax

properties.displayName: SYSTEM process launched from user-writable path
properties.description:
Detects SYSTEM-level LOLBin processes (e.g., cmd.exe, powershell.exe, rundll32.exe) writing or modifying suspicious file types (executables, scripts, etc.) in user-writable locations (Users, AppData, Temp, ProgramData, Downloads). Suppresses known benign installer and support tool activity.

Flags strong post-exploitation behaviors, such as privilege escalation or malware staging.

Check if parent process or command matches allowlists (installer, support, EDR tools).
Review file type and target path for legitimacy.
Investigate unknown parents or unusual command lines for potential abuse.
Update allowlists if benign activity is repeatedly flagged.
properties.query:
// =====================================
// LOLBin abuse (SYSTEM) -> only when it writes risky files
// =====================================
let Lookback = 7d;
let SuspiciousExt = dynamic([
  ".exe",".dll",".js",".vbs",".hta",".ps1",".bat",".cmd",
  ".lnk",".cpl",".scr",".jar",".iso",".img"
]);
// Maintainable allowlists
let AllowedParents = dynamic([
  "serviceshell.exe",
  "wavessyssvc64.exe",
  "nvmup.exe",
  "sre.exe",
  "expressconnect.exe",
  "cursor.exe",
  "intel-ppm-provisioning-package_d6rt2_win64_8.0.0_a00_03.exe",
  "cmd.exe",
  "msiexec.exe",
  "mpcmdrun.exe",
  "code.exe",
  "_conda.exe"
]);
let AllowedCmdRegex = dynamic([
  @"cmd\.exe\s+/c\s+copy\s+/y\s+c:\\programdata\\rivetnetworks\\expressconnect\\aps\.log\s+~c:\\programdata\\rivetnetworks\\expressconnect\\aps\.log\s+>\s*nul",
  @"cmd\.exe\s+/c\s+.*\\programdata\\dell\\drivers\\[0-9a-f\-]+\\add_intelppm\.bat",
  @"cursor\.exe.*--type=(crashpad-handler|gpu-process|utility).*\\windows\\system32\\config\\systemprofile\\appdata\\roaming\\cursor",
  @"expand.*\\programdata\\dell\\supportassist\\",
  @"certutil\.exe\s+-f\s+-addstore\s+""?dell trust""?\s+.*bradburybinarysignedcerti\.cer",
  @"cmd\.exe\s+/c.*fsutil\.exe\s+usn\s+queryjournal\s+c:",
  @"code\.exe.*--type=(crashpad-handler|gpu-process|utility|renderer)"
]);
let Lolbins = dynamic([
  "cmd.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","expand.exe",
  "rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe",
  "cscript.exe","powershell.exe"
]);
// --------------- Core LOLBin process selection + suppressions ----------------
let LolbinBase =
(
  DeviceProcessEvents
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
  | where AccountSid == "S-1-5-18"
  | where InitiatingProcessFolderPath !contains "dell"
    and InitiatingProcessFolderPath !contains "wavessyssvc64"
  // Normalize
  | extend
      file   = tolower(FileName),
      parent = tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName),
      cmd    = tolower(ProcessCommandLine),
      folder = tolower(FolderPath),
      ipath  = tolower(InitiatingProcessFolderPath)
  // Scope to real LOLBins
  | where file in~ (Lolbins)
  // Behaviors indicative of LOLBin abuse
  | where cmd matches regex @"\b(copy|move|echo|type|certutil|bitsadmin|powershell.*-enc|cmd\.exe /c|powershell.*new-item|expand|rundll32|regsvr32|mshta|wscript|cscript)\b"
  // User-writable touchpoints
  | where cmd has_any ("c:\\users\\","\\appdata\\","\\windows\\temp\\","\\programdata\\","\\downloads\\")
  // ---------- High-volume benign suppressions ----------
  // A) Chromium/Electron helpers (avoid LOLBin+--type=... noise)
  | where not (file == "rundll32.exe" and cmd matches regex @"--type=(renderer|gpu-process|utility|crashpad-handler)")
  // B) MSI custom actions invoking rundll32 (InstallShield/Rivet/Killer)
  | where not (file == "rundll32.exe" and parent == "msiexec.exe"
               and cmd matches regex @"(customactions|\\windows\\temp\\_is[0-9a-f]+\.tmp|sfxca)")
  // C) Dell trust-store seeding via certutil from msiexec
  | where not (file == "certutil.exe" and parent == "msiexec.exe"
               and cmd matches regex @"-addstore\s+""?dell trust""?")
  // D) Defender Support diagnostic (MpCmdRun -> fsutil usn queryjournal)
  | where not (file == "cmd.exe" and parent == "mpcmdrun.exe"
               and cmd has "fsutil.exe usn queryjournal")
  // ---------- Your existing suppression model ----------
  // (1) cmd.exe child with trusted parent
  | where not (file == "cmd.exe" and parent in (AllowedParents))
  // (2) Parent trusted AND command-line matches an allowed pattern
  | extend AllowedCmdHit =
         (cmd matches regex tostring(AllowedCmdRegex[0]))
      or (cmd matches regex tostring(AllowedCmdRegex[1]))
      or (cmd matches regex tostring(AllowedCmdRegex[2]))
      or (cmd matches regex tostring(AllowedCmdRegex[3]))
      or (cmd matches regex tostring(AllowedCmdRegex[4]))
      or (cmd matches regex tostring(AllowedCmdRegex[5]))
      or (cmd matches regex tostring(AllowedCmdRegex[6]))
  | where not (parent in (AllowedParents) and AllowedCmdHit)
  // Keep columns needed for join
  | project TimeGenerated, DeviceId, ProcessId, InitiatingProcessAccountSid,
            DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
            InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath
);
// ---------------- Join only when it writes risky files ----------------
LolbinBase
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    // Writes only
    | where ActionType in~ ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
    // Compute target extension
    | extend TargetExt = tolower(strcat('.', extract(@"\.([a-z0-9]+)$", 1, FileName)))
    | where TargetExt in~ (SuspiciousExt)
    // Keep in user-writable locations as an extra guard (optional; keep/adjust if desired)
    | where FolderPath has_any ("c:\\users\\","\\appdata\\","\\windows\\temp\\","\\programdata\\","\\downloads\\")
    | project DeviceId, InitiatingProcessAccountSid, InitiatingProcessId= InitiatingProcessId,
              FileEventTime=TimeGenerated, TargetFile=FolderPath, FileAction=ActionType, TargetExt
) on DeviceId, $left.ProcessId == $right.InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessAccountSid
| project-away InitiatingProcessId
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    FileEventTime,
    DeviceName,
    FileName,
    FolderPath,
    ProcessCommandLine,
    InitiatingProcessFileName,
    InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
    TargetFile,
    TargetExt,
    FileAction
| order by FileEventTime desc, TimeGenerated desc

properties.displayName: Suspicious SSH Traffic not on port 22 connecting to public IP addresses

properties.displayName: Port scan detected  (ASIM Network Session schema)
properties.description:
This rule identifies a possible port scan, in which a single source tries to access a large number of different ports is a short time frame. This may indicate that a [port scanner](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Port_scanner) is trying to identify open ports in order to penetrate a system.
This analytic rule uses [ASIM](https://aka.ms/AboutASIM) and supports any built-in or custom source that supports the ASIM NetworkSession schema
properties.query:
let PortScanThreshold = 50;
_Im_NetworkSession
| where ipv4_is_private(SrcIpAddr) == False
| where SrcIpAddr !in ("127.0.0.1", "::1")
| summarize AttemptedPortsCount=dcount(DstPortNumber), AttemptedPorts=make_set(DstPortNumber, 100), ReportedBy=make_set(strcat(EventVendor, "/", EventProduct), 20) by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where AttemptedPortsCount > PortScanThreshold

properties.displayName: Excessive number of failed connections from a single source (ASIM Network Session schema)
properties.description:
This rule identifies a single source that generates an excessive amount of failed connections. Modify the threshold to change the sensitivity of the rule: the higher the threshold, the less sensitive is the rule and less incidents will be generated.
 This analytic rule uses [ASIM](https://aka.ms/AboutASIM) and supports any built-in or custom source that supports the ASIM NetworkSession schema
properties.query:
let threshold = 5000;
_Im_NetworkSession(eventresult='Failure')
| summarize Count=count() by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated,5m)
| where Count > threshold
| extend timestamp = TimeGenerated, threshold

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Excessive number of failed connections from {{SrcIpAddr}}
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: The client at address {{SrcIpAddr}} generated more than {{threshold}} failures over a 5 minutes time window, which may indicate malicious activity.

properties.displayName: Malformed user agent
properties.description: Malware authors will sometimes hardcode user agent string values when writing the network communication component of their malware. Malformed user agents can be an indication of such malware.
properties.query:
(union isfuzzy=true
(OfficeActivity | where UserAgent != ""),
(OfficeActivity
| where RecordType in ("AzureActiveDirectory", "AzureActiveDirectoryStsLogon")
| extend OperationName = Operation
| parse ExtendedProperties with * 'User-Agent\\":\\"' UserAgent2 '\\' *
| parse ExtendedProperties with * 'UserAgent",      "Value": "' UserAgent1 '"' *
| where isnotempty(UserAgent1) or isnotempty(UserAgent2)
| extend UserAgent = iff( RecordType == 'AzureActiveDirectoryStsLogon', UserAgent1, UserAgent2)
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated) by UserAgent, SourceIP = ClientIP, Account = UserId, Type, RecordType, Operation
),
(AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceType =~ "APPLICATIONGATEWAYS"
| where OperationName =~ "ApplicationGatewayAccess"
| extend ClientIP = columnifexists("clientIP_s", "None"), UserAgent = columnifexists("userAgent_s", "None")
| where UserAgent != '-'
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated) by UserAgent, SourceIP = ClientIP,  requestUri_s, httpMethod_s, host_s, requestQuery_s, Type
),
(
W3CIISLog
| where isnotempty(csUserAgent)
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated) by UserAgent = csUserAgent, SourceIP = cIP, Account = csUserName, Type, sSiteName, csMethod, csUriStem
),
(
AWSCloudTrail
| where isnotempty(UserAgent)
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated) by UserAgent, SourceIP = SourceIpAddress, Account = UserIdentityUserName, Type, EventSource, EventName
),
(SigninLogs
| where isnotempty(UserAgent)
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated) by UserAgent, SourceIP = IPAddress, Account = UserPrincipalName, Type, OperationName, tostring(LocationDetails), tostring(DeviceDetail), AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed
),
(AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where isnotempty(UserAgent)
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated) by UserAgent, SourceIP = IPAddress, Account = UserPrincipalName, Type, OperationName, tostring(LocationDetails), tostring(DeviceDetail), AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed
)
)
// Likely artefact of hardcoding
| where UserAgent startswith "User" or UserAgent startswith '\"'
// Incorrect casing
or (UserAgent startswith "Mozilla" and not(UserAgent contains_cs "Mozilla"))
// Incorrect casing
or UserAgent contains_cs  "(Compatible;"
// Missing MSIE version
or UserAgent matches regex @"MSIE\s?;"
// Incorrect spacing around MSIE version
or UserAgent matches regex  @"MSIE(?:\d|.{1,5}?\d\s;)"
| extend AccountName = split(Account, "@")[0], UPNSuffix = split(Account, "@")[1]

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Malformed user agent
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Malware authors will sometimes hardcode user agent string values when writing the network communication component of their malware.  Malformed user agents can be an indication of such malware.

properties.description:

Log4j is an open-source Apache logging library that is used in many Java-based applications. The regex and the string matching look for the most common attacks. This might not be comprehensive to detect every possible user agent variation.

properties.displayName: Users being added to Network tools admin group
properties.description: This alert triggers when a user is added to the Network tools admin group. Monitoring this activity is crucial as it can indicate potential unauthorized access or privilege escalation within the network.
properties.query:
AuditLogs
| where Category == "GroupManagement"
| where OperationName == "Add member to group"
| extend GroupName = tostring(parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties))[1].newValue)))
| extend UserName = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
| extend InitiatedBy= tostring(parse_json(tostring(InitiatedBy.app)).displayName)
| where GroupName contains "FMC Admins" or GroupName contains "M365-admins" or GroupName contains "Orion BTE - Super Admins" or  GroupName contains "PG-GlobalAdmin" or GroupName contains "SolarWinds Orion Admins"

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: A user has been added to Network Tools Admin Groups

properties.displayName: High Risk User Compressing Files
properties.description: This alert will alert when any user on the high risk watchlist compresses any file.
properties.query:
let High_Risk = (_GetWatchlist('High_Risk_Watchlist') | project SearchKey);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName in ("winrar.exe", "7z.exe", "winzip.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine contains ".zip" or ProcessCommandLine contains ".rar" or ProcessCommandLine contains ".7z"
| where AccountUpn in (High_Risk)
| project AccountDomain, AccountName, AccountUpn, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessMD5, InitiatingProcessParentFileName, InitiatingProcessSHA256, InitiatingProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName, ProcessCommandLine, ProcessCreationTime, ProcessVersionInfoProductName, InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionDeviceName, InitiatingProcessRemoteSessionIP

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: A High Risk User has Compressed Files using Winrar, 7zip or Winzip

properties.displayName: High Risk permissions being assigned to applications
properties.description: This alert triggers when an application is granted one or more high-risk permissions that could pose a security or compliance threat to the environment. High-risk permissions include those that allow full access to user data, impersonation of users, modification of directory settings, or privileged access to sensitive resources.
properties.query:
let High_Risk_Permissions = dynamic(["User.Read.All", "Group.Read.All", "Sites.Read.All", "Sites.ReadWrite.All", "Application.Read.All", "Sites.FullControl.All", "Directory.Read.All", "User.ReadWrite.All", "Group.ReadWrite.All", "Directory.ReadWrite.All", "Files.Read.All", "Files.ReadWrite.All", "Application.ReadWrite.All", "AuditLog.Read.All", "Calendars.ReadWrite", "Content.SuperUser", "Mail.ReadWrite", "Tenant.Read.All", "Mail.Send", "Device.Read.All", "Organization.Read.All", "User-Mail.ReadWrite.All"]);
AuditLogs
| where OperationName == "Add app role assignment to service principal"
| extend AppName = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
| extend AppId = tostring(TargetResources[0].id)
| extend Permission_Level = parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties))[1].newValue))
| extend Permission_Description = parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties))[2].newValue))
| extend LastModifiedDateTime = parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties))[4].newValue))
| extend ServicePrincipalDisplayName =  parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties))[6].newValue))
| where Permission_Level in (High_Risk_Permissions)
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceId, ActivityDisplayName, ActivityDateTime, Type, AppName, AADOperationType, Permission_Level, Permission_Description, LastModifiedDateTime, ServicePrincipalDisplayName, Result, AdditionalDetails, InitiatedBy

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: High Risk Permission Assigned to an Applications
